findings: Immediate-origin and completed-path-origin partitions both failed the exact one-joint control by admitting opposing outputs together at upper contact; five joints correctly did not execute for either candidate.
Existing connected outcome-source topology groups genuine one-joint alternatives and separates disconnected anonymous modules without using joint labels direction pose or hand knowledge.

Applying that factorization to both output choice and fresh-opportunity allocation preserved the exact one-joint arrow and closed both components in the two-joint rung before the five-joint rung executed.

All five serial components reached and left both limits, used both motor signs, survived reverse registration and proximal perturbation, replayed exactly, quiesced naturally, and exhausted no propagation budget.
Measured comparisons scans and total work stayed inside the declared activity-normalized product bounds; the warm representative core suite completed in 0.19 seconds.
residual_uncertainty: This is validated development evidence from a dirty worktree, not frozen benchmark authority or accepted-default promotion.
Five serial anonymous joints establish compositional articulation in this harness; they do not yet establish a multi-finger grasping hand or transfer to a new morphology.
A later campaign should ablate component-local output choice and component-local opportunity separately, and test how genuine learned cross-component links should merge components.
